named-query.name: Expedicao.listarPorPeriodoESituacao
named-query.query: select new br.com.turmalina.dto.ExpedicaoResumo( e.codigo, e.titulo, c.nomeOficial, e.inicioPrevisto, e.terminoPrevisto, e.situacao) from Expedicao e join e.caverna c where e.inicioPrevisto >= :inicio and e.inicioPrevisto < :fim and e.situacao = :situacao order by e.inicioPrevisto

named-query.name: Coleta.listarPorExpedicao
named-query.query: select c from Coleta c join fetch c.setor join fetch c.responsavel where c.expedicao.id = :expedicaoId order by c.dataHora
